40021655.author: पदार्थः
40021655.content: तत्र there, उपविष्टम् seated, राजानम् the king, उपासन्ते attend upon, विचक्षणाः wise men, कथानाम् of stories, बहुरूपाणाम् of many kinds, हास्यकाराः jesters, समन्ततः all around.

40021655.author: Translation
40021655.content: There, wise men, jesters, and storytellers of various kinds surrounded and attended upon the seated king.

40021656.author: पदार्थः
40021656.content: विजयः Vijaya, मधुमत्तः Madhumatta, च and, काश्यपः Kashyapa, मङ्गलः Mangala, कुटः Kuta, सुराजः Suraja, कालियः Kaliya, भद्रः Bhadra, दन्तवक्रः Dantavakra, सुमागधः Sumagadha.

40021656.author: Translation
40021656.content: These were the names of some of the attendees: Vijaya, Madhumatta, Kashyapa, Mangala, Kuta, Suraja, Kaliya, Bhadra, Dantavakra, and Sumagadha.

40021657.author: पदार्थः
40021657.content: एते these, कथाः stories, बहुविधाः of many kinds, परिहाससमन्विताः full of jokes, कथयन्ति tell, स्म (past tense indicator), संहृष्टाः delighted, राघवस्य of Rama, महात्मनः the great-souled.

40021657.author: Translation
40021657.content: These delighted individuals used to tell the great-souled Rama many kinds of stories filled with humor.

40021658.author: पदार्थः
40021658.content: ततः then, कथायाम् in a story, कस्याञ्चित् in a certain, राघवः Rama, समभाषत spoke, काः what, कथाः stories, नगरे in the city, भद्र O good one, वर्तन्ते are current, विषयेषु in the provinces, च and.

40021658.author: Translation
40021658.content: Then, during a certain conversation, Rama spoke, asking, "O good one, what stories are current in the city and in the provinces?"

40021659.author: पदार्थः
40021659.content: माम् me, आश्रितानि concerning, कानि what, आहुः say, पौरजानपदाः citizens and country people, जनाः people, किं च and what, सीताम् Sita, समाश्रित्य concerning, भरतम् Bharata, किं च and what, लक्ष्मणम् Lakshmana

40021659.author: Translation
40021659.content: What do the city dwellers and country folk say about me, and what do they say about Sita, Bharata, and Lakshmana?

40021660.author: पदार्थः
40021660.content: किं नु and what, शत्रुघ्नम् Shatrughna, उद्दिश्य concerning, कैकयीम् Kaikeyi, किं नु and what, मातरम् mother, वक्तव्यताम् subject of criticism, च and, राजानः kings, वरे in the excellent, राज्ये kingdom, व्रजन्ति become, च and

40021660.author: Translation
40021660.content: What do they say about Shatrughna, and what about mother Kaikeyi, and what kind of criticism do kings face in an excellent kingdom?

40021661.author: पदार्थः
40021661.content: एवम् thus, उक्ते having been spoken, तु indeed, रामेण by Rama, भद्रः Bhadra, प्राञ्जलिः with folded hands, अब्रवीत् said, स्थिताः existing, कथाः stories, शुभाः auspicious, राजन् O King, वर्तन्ते are current, पुरवासिनाम् among the city dwellers

40021661.author: Translation
40021661.content: When Rama had thus spoken, Bhadra, with folded hands, replied, "O King, auspicious talks are indeed current among the city dwellers."

40021662.author: पदार्थः
40021662.content: अमुम् this, तु indeed, विजयम् victory, सौम्य O gentle one, दशग्रीववधार्जितम् obtained by the slaying of Dashagriva, भूयिष्ठम् mostly, स्वपुरे in your city, पौरैः by the citizens, कथ्यन्ते are narrated, पुरुषर्षभ O best among men

40021662.author: Translation
40021662.content: O gentle one, O best among men, this victory, indeed, obtained by the slaying of Dashagriva, is mostly narrated by the citizens in your city.

40021663.author: पदार्थः
40021663.content: एवम् thus, उक्तः having been spoken to, तु indeed, भद्रेण by Bhadra, राघवः Rama, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke, कथयस्व tell, यथातत्त्वम् truthfully, सर्वम् all, निरवशेषतः completely

40021663.author: Translation
40021663.content: When Bhadra had thus spoken, Rama indeed replied, "Tell everything truthfully and completely, without omitting anything."

40021664.author: पदार्थः
40021664.content: शुभाशुभानि good and bad, वाक्यानि words, यानि which, आहुः say, पुरवासिनः city dwellers, श्रुत्वा having heard, इदानीं now, शुभं good, कुर्यां I should do, न not, कुर्याम् I should do, अशुभानि bad, च and

40021664.author: Translation
40021664.content: Having heard the good and bad words spoken by the city dwellers, I should now do what is good and avoid what is bad.

40021665.author: पदार्थः
40021665.content: कथयस्व tell, च and, विस्रब्धः confidently, निर्भयं fearlessly, विगतज्वरः free from anxiety, कथयन्ति speak, यथा as, पौराः citizens, पापाः wicked things (or wicked people), जनपदेषु in the districts, च and

40021665.author: Translation
40021665.content: Speak confidently, fearlessly, and without anxiety, just as the citizens and people in the districts speak, even about wicked things.

40021666.author: पदार्थः
40021666.content: राघवेण by Rama, एवम् thus, उक्तः spoken, तु indeed, भद्रः Bhadra, सुरुचिरं very pleasing, वचः words, प्रत्युवाच replied, महाबाहुं to the mighty-armed (Rama), प्राञ्जलिः with folded hands, सुसमाहितः very attentive

40021666.author: Translation
40021666.content: Thus addressed by Rama, Bhadra, with folded hands and great attention, replied with very pleasing words to the mighty-armed king.

40021667.author: पदार्थः
40021667.content: शृणु listen, राजन् O King, यथा as, पौराः citizens, कथयन्ति speak, शुभाशुभम् good and bad, चत्वर squares, आपण markets, रथ्यासु in the streets, वनेषु in the forests, उपवनेषु in the gardens, च and

40021667.author: Translation
40021667.content: O King, listen to how the citizens speak of good and bad things in the squares, markets, streets, forests, and gardens.

40021668.author: पदार्थः
40021668.content: दुष्करं difficult, कृतवान् has done, रामः Rama, समुद्रे in the ocean, सेतुबन्धनम् the building of a bridge, अश्रुतं unheard of, पूर्वकैः by ancestors, कैश्चित् by anyone, देवैः by gods, अपि even, सदानवैः along with Danavas

40021668.author: Translation
40021668.content: Rama has accomplished the impossible task of building a bridge in the ocean, a feat unheard of by any ancestors, gods, or even demons.

40021669.author: पदार्थः
40021669.content: रावणश्च Rāvaṇa and, दुराधर्षो formidable, हतः killed, सबलवाहनः with his army and vehicles, वानराश्च and monkeys, वशं under control, नीता brought, ऋक्षाश्च and bears, सह with, राक्षसैः the Rākṣasas.

40021669.author: Translation
40021669.content: The formidable Rāvaṇa was killed along with his army and vehicles, and the monkeys and bears were brought under control along with the Rākṣasas.

40021670.author: पदार्थः
40021670.content: हत्वा having killed, च and, रावणं Rāvaṇa, सङ्ख्ये in battle, सीताम् Sītā, आहृत्य having brought back, राघवः Rāma, अमर्षं indignation, पृष्ठतः behind, कृत्वा having placed, स्ववेश्म to his own house, पुनः again, आनयत् brought.

40021670.author: Translation
40021670.content: Having killed Rāvaṇa in battle and brought Sītā back, Rāma set aside his indignation and brought her back to his own house.

40021671.author: पदार्थः
40021671.content: कीदृशं of what kind, हृदये in the heart, तस्य his, सीतासम्भोगजं born from union with Sītā, सुखम् happiness, अङ्कम् on his lap, आरोप्य having placed, तु indeed, पुरा formerly, रावणेन by Rāvaṇa, बलात् by force, धृताम् seized.

40021671.author: Translation
40021671.content: What kind of happiness, born from union with Sītā, could be in his heart, when she was previously forcibly seized and placed on his lap by Rāvaṇa?

40021672.author: पदार्थः
40021672.content: लङ्काम् to Laṅkā, अपि even, पुरा formerly, नीताम् taken, अशोकवनिकाम् to the Aśoka grove, गताम् gone, रक्षसां of Rākṣasas, वशम् under the control, आपन्नां having fallen, कथं how, रामः Rāma, न not, कुत्सते despises.

40021672.author: Translation
40021672.content: How can Rāma not despise her, who was formerly taken to Laṅkā, went to the Aśoka grove, and fell under the control of Rākṣasas?

40021673.author: पदार्थः
40021673.content: अस्माकम् of us, अपि even, दारेषु regarding wives, सहनीयं to be endured, भविष्यति it will be, यथा as, हि indeed, कुरुते does, राजा the king, प्रजा the subjects, तम् him, अनुवर्तते follow.

40021673.author: Translation
40021673.content: If the king acts this way, then even for us, regarding our wives, such things will become tolerable, because indeed, as the king acts, so do the subjects follow him.

40021674.author: पदार्थः
40021674.content: एवम् thus, बहुविधाः various kinds of, वाचः words, वदन्ति they speak, पुरवासिनः city dwellers, नगरेषु in cities, च and, सर्वेषु in all, राजन् O King, जनपदेषु in districts, च and.

40021674.author: Translation
40021674.content: O King, thus, the city dwellers speak various kinds of words in all cities and districts.

40021675.author: पदार्थः
40021675.content: तस्य his, एवम् thus, भाषितम् words, श्रुत्वा having heard, राघवः Rama, परमार्तवत् like one greatly distressed, उवाच he said, सुहृदः friends, सर्वान् all, कथम् how, एतत् this, ब्रवीथ you speak, माम् to me.

40021675.author: Translation
40021675.content: Having heard his words, Rama, greatly distressed, asked all his friends, "How can you say this to me?"

40021676.author: पदार्थः
40021676.content: सर्वे all, तु indeed, शिरसा with their heads, भूमौ on the ground, अभिवाद्य having saluted, प्रणम्य having bowed down, च and, प्रत्यूचुः they replied, राघवम् to Rama, दीनम् distressed, एवम् thus, एतत् this, न not, संशयः doubt.

40021676.author: Translation
40021676.content: All of them, having saluted and bowed down with their heads to the ground, replied to the distressed Rama, "This is indeed so, there is no doubt."

40021677.author: पदार्थः
40021677.content: श्रुत्वा having heard, तु indeed, वाक्यम् the words, काकुत्स्थः Rama, सर्वेषाम् of all, समुदीरितम् uttered, विसर्जयामास he dismissed, तदा then, वयस्यान् his friends, शत्रुसूदनः the destroyer of enemies.

40021677.author: Translation
40021677.content: Having heard the words uttered by all, Rama, the destroyer of enemies, then dismissed his friends. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे त्रिचत्वारिंशः सर्गः ।। 43 ।। Thus ends the forty-third sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
